cityZh: 中國 - 水墨星空夜（張家界+大唐不夜城）
cityEn: China - Ink-Wash Starry Night (Zhangjiajie + Datang Never Night City)
descZh: 中國地域廣闊，擁有眾多適合夜遊的古鎮、長城與都市夜景；夜色之中，傳統建築燈光與現代繁華交織，獨具東方氣韻。
descEn: China offers ancient towns, Great Wall views and vibrant city nightscapes. Traditional lighting blends with modern glamour.
customZh: 當地禮儀：參觀古蹟請保持安靜；部分景區有夜遊專用通道；建議預約。
customEn: Etiquette: Keep quiet at heritage sites. Many night tours require advance booking.

cityZh: 日本 - 禪意霓虹夜（新宿+祇園夜櫻）
cityEn: Japan - Zen Neon Night (Shinjuku + Gion Night Cherry Blossoms)
descZh: 日本的夜間景點充滿幽靜美感：神社燈籠、河畔夜色、都市霓虹，營造出寧靜又浪漫的氛圍。
descEn: Japanese nightscapes feature shrine lanterns, river views and neon city lights — quiet yet romantic.
customZh: 公共場所請降低音量；垃圾盡量自行帶走；遵守景區參觀規則。
customEn: Keep voice low in public spaces. Take trash with you. Follow site rules.

cityZh: 韓國 - K-POP 月光野餐（漢江+釜山）
cityEn: South Korea - K-POP Moonlight Picnic (Han River + Busan)
descZh: 韓國的夜遊融合現代潮流與傳統宮殿燈光，明洞、北村、漢江夜景都是年輕人喜愛的目的地。
descEn: Korean night tours blend modern trends with lit palaces. Han River and historic districts are popular spots.
customZh: 街邊飲食區請保持整潔；宮殿夜遊需留意開放時間。
customEn: Keep street‑food areas clean. Check opening hours for palace night viewings.

cityZh: 泰國 - 金廟湄南河天燈夜
cityEn: Thailand - Golden Temple & Chao Phraya River Sky Lantern Night
descZh: 泰國夜市、寺廟夜燈、河上遊船，熱帶夜風伴隨香氣與燈光，充滿熱情活力。
descEn: Thailand’s night markets, lit temples and river cruises offer warm, vibrant tropical evenings.
customZh: 參觀寺廟注意衣著得體；尊重當地禮節；夜間出行留意安全。
customEn: Dress modestly at temples. Respect local customs. Stay safe at night.

descZh: 芬蘭以極光、森林、湖泊夜間風光聞名；長夜之中，寧靜的北歐夜色與極光奇觀吸引無多旅行者。
descEn: Finland is famous for auroras, forests and lake nightscapes. Long Nordic nights offer magical quiet views.
customZh: 留意天氣與保暖；進入森林請跟隨導遊；尊重薩米人文化。
customEn: Prepare for cold weather. Stay with guides in forests. Respect Sámi culture.
